description:
Create a traffic accident reconstruction sketch in EdrawMax for a police report. 

Scenario: A T-bone collision occurred at the intersection of 'Oak Street' (running North-South) and 'Pine Avenue' (running East-West). 

Requirements:
1. Open EdrawMax and start a new drawing (you can use the 'Floor Plan' or 'Crime Scene' categories/libraries).
2. Draw a 4-way intersection labeled with the street names 'Oak Street' and 'Pine Avenue'.
3. Place a North Arrow symbol indicating orientation.
4. Place Vehicle 1 (a Blue Sedan) traveling North on Oak Street in the intersection.
5. Place Vehicle 2 (a Red SUV) traveling East on Pine Avenue colliding with Vehicle 1.
6. Add 'Skid marks' behind the Blue Sedan to show braking.
7. Add a text box with the title 'Case #2024-891'.
8. Save the diagram as 'accident_sketch_2024_891.eddx' in /home/ga/Documents/.
9. Export the diagram as a PDF named 'accident_sketch_2024_891.pdf' in the same folder.

Note: If startup dialogs appear, dismiss them.
